summary: Navajo Reservation International Derrick tower, built 1941 per NHLR; 83 ft with 7x7 cab, registered 2002, listed standing; no staffing or visit data found.

facts.design: International Derrick design tower; 83-ft tower with 7x7-ft metal cab
facts.agency: Navajo Indian Reservation; Bureau of Indian Affairs cooperator

events.note: NHLR says the tower was constructed in 1941; neither source names a builder
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on July 20, 2002 as US 438, AZ 34

evidence.supports: Built in 1941 as an 83-ft tower with a 7x7 metal cab, in active service
evidence.quote: Oak Ridge Lookout is an 83’ tower with a 7’x7’ metal cab was constructed in 1941 and is in active service.

evidence.supports: One of the International Derrick design towers on the Navajo Reservation
evidence.quote: One of the International Derrick design towers located on the Navajo Reservation.

evidence.supports: Bureau of Indian Affairs is the cooperator
Listed as Oak Ridge, standing, NHLR US 438, AZ 34
evidence.quote: Oak Ridge Apache 35.60158 -109.24275 Tower Standing NHLR US 438, AZ 34

notes_for_editor: Brief access 'permission' is not supported by any source read, so no access level is set. Brief agency matches the NHLR administered-by line. NHLR 'in active service' is undated. Two WebSearch queries found no history of the tower. An undated KTAR article about an Oak Ridge wildfire was not linked to the tower and is not used. Staffing, fires and visitor status are unknown.
